text:
ashley: Quick heads-up — I hit a few 404s in guides/serve-fast-onboard.md (curl example + an onboarding diagram). I opened a tiny PR for the curl snippet and swapped the CDN URL, but the image needs rehosting. Who's the current owner?

raj: Thanks for catching this. Can you drop the PR link? pinging @kelsey in case this is in her area.

ashley: PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — the curl change is one-line. Problem image path is: https://cdn.example.com/assets/onboard/diagram-v1.png (404). Also the curl example that failed was: ```bash
curl -sS https://docs.redwood.ai/serve/quickstart/curl | jq
```

kelsey: @ashley @raj I'm the doc owner for onboarding guides. Thx for the PR. I'll rehost the diagram to our assets bucket and push a follow-up. Can you confirm alt text for the image?

ashley: Suggested alt: "serve fast onboarding flow — request routing and cache layers"

sam: Quick note — when rehosting, use the /assets/v2/ prefix so the CDN purge picks it up. Also add an explicit width attribute in the MDX to avoid layout shift.

deploy-bot: PR #1234 checks: lint ✓, link-check ✗ (found 1 broken external link), image-check ✗

kelsey: Got it. I'll upload to gs://redwood-assets/assets/v2/onboard/diagram-v2.png and update the doc. Might need a tiny lint tweak (MDX lint) — I'll run locally. @ashley can you do a review once I push?

ashley: :thumbsup: Yep, will review after you push.

raj: If we want to avoid a follow-up, infra could add a redirect from the old CDN path for a short window. I can open a ticket if you want me to.

kelsey: That'd be helpful, @raj — please open ticket INF-487. Pushed a commit to the PR with the rehost + alt text + width attr: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234/files. Fixed the MDX lint locally, re-ran link-check — all green now.

deploy-bot: PR #1234 checks: lint ✓, link-check ✓, image-check ✓ — ready to merge

ashley: Reviewing now, looks good. Small suggestion on wording in the second paragraph — left a one-line comment.

kelsey: Addressed the wording nits, thanks. Merging after CI. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround! :rocket:
